title: LoopRPT: Reinforcement Pre-Training for Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.19714v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Looped language models (LoopLMs) perform iterative latent computation to refine internal representations, offering an alternative to explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. However, existing reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms primarily target output tokens, creating a structural mismatch with looped architectures whose reasoning unfolds implicitly. In this work, we propose LoopRPT, a reinforcement pre-training framework tailored for LoopLMs. By reframing next-token prediction as a next-token reasoning task, LoopRPT assigns reinforcement signals directly to latent steps using an EMA teacher reference and noisy latent rollouts. This formulation enables RL to directly shape intermediate representations, compressing effective reasoning into fewer iterations. We instantiate LoopRPT on Ouro across multiple model scales. translated_title: LoopRPT：面向循环语言模型的强化预训练
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型通过迭代式潜空间计算来精炼内部表示，为显式的思维链推理提供了一种替代方案。然而，现有的强化学习范式主要针对输出词元，这与推理以隐式方式展开的循环架构存在结构性错配。在本工作中，我们提出了LoopRPT，一个专为循环语言模型量身定制的强化预训练框架。通过将下一词元预测重新构建为下一词元推理任务，LoopRPT利用EMA教师参考和带噪声的潜空间轨迹，将强化信号直接分配到潜空间计算步骤上。这一构建方式使强化学习能够直接塑造中间表示，将有效推理压缩至更少的迭代次数中。我们在多种模型规模的Ouro模型上实例化了LoopRPT。结果表明，LoopRPT提升了每一步表示的质量，并在准确率-计算量的权衡中实现了帕累托最优。
tldr: LoopRPT提出了一种专为循环语言模型设计的强化预训练框架，通过将下一词元预测重构为推理任务并把强化信号直接作用于潜空间计算步骤，使循环模型能以更少的迭代次数实现更高质量的隐式推理。
en_tdlr: LoopRPT is a reinforcement pre-training framework tailored for looped language models that reframes next-token prediction as next-token reasoning, directly shaping latent computation steps to achieve Pareto-dominant implicit reasoning with fewer iterations.
